title: Category $\mcal O$ for polynomial toroidal algebras and its subalgebras
summary: In this paper we study Category $\mcal O$ for the polynomial toroidal Lie algebras and its $S,H$ type subalgebras. We classify irreducible objects of category $\mcal O$ as unique irreducble quotient of standard modules. Surprisingly, costandard objects of category $\mcal O$ arrises from Shen-Larsson type modules. We determine necessary sufficient conditions for irreducibility of Shen-Larsson modules.
